title: My Neighborhood
text:
My neighborhood is small and quiet. There is a park near my house. Many children play there after school.

There is also a small shop on the corner. The shop sells bread, milk and fruit. I like my neighborhood because it is friendly.

questions.text: What is near the writer's house?
What does the shop on the corner sell?
Why does the writer like the neighborhood?
Why do children probably go to the park after school?

vocabulary.definition: an area with grass and trees where people go to relax or play
the place where two streets meet
kind and pleasant to be with

paragraph_translations: Meu bairro é pequeno e tranquilo. Há um parque perto da minha casa. Muitas crianças brincam lá depois da escola.
Também há uma pequena loja na esquina. A loja vende pão, leite e frutas. Eu gosto do meu bairro porque ele é amigável.
